featured.title: Beginner Pickleball
featured.body: Join us every Wednesday from 6–8 PM at Dink Club for Beginner & Intermediate Round-Robin Play! These welcoming sessions are designed specifically for newer and entry-level players—so there’s no pressure and no need to feel intimidated. Everyone is learning, playing, and having fun together! 😊
